name: Spot Noise (Motion Blurred Particles near Contour Surfaces)
definition: A technique for visualizing 3D velocity fields near a contour surface by rendering motion-blurred particles (ellipsoids) within a thickened region around the surface, using hardware rendering for interactive speed.
summary: Spot noise visualizes 3D velocity fields using motion-blurred ellipsoidal particles near contour surfaces, distinctively operating on surfaces unrelated to the flow direction.
